content.short: Umbria Network provides a fast cross-chain bridge that rewards liquidity providers.
content.description: Umbria Network’s Narni bridge is a capital-efficient, multi-chain asset bridge that enables cheap, fast bi-directional transfers between Ethereum Mainnet and a wide range of EVM-compatible blockchains. It uses a novel liquidity provision protocol that substantially lowers cross-chain transfer costs compared with traditional validator-driven mint/burn and lock/unlock bridges, while also delivering faster finality. This design helps developers and users move assets seamlessly across ecosystems with minimal friction and improved efficiency.
content.meta: Umbria Network Narni bridge enables fast cross-chain transfers between Ethereum and EVM chains. Discover Umbria Network and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
